basic_info.description: Charming NOE VALLEY Victorian Duplex WITH BIG BACKYARD! *AND Finished EXTRA unit downstairs too!* Perfect 1031X property! Beautiful newly painted front facade w/gold luster accents in a prime location-JUST A BLOCK up from coveted 24th Street! UPPER unit delivered VACANT. Lower unit occupied & rented at $4,250mo. BOTH units have TWO bedrooms PLUS large BONUS ROOM (great for3rd BEDROOM, office, guests or second living room) & 1 bathroom, a Kitchen, Dining Room, Living Room & IN UNIT laundry! BOTH units have beautiful hardwood floors (upstairs refinished 2024, downstairs new in 2022). BOTH units have tall living room ceilings & upstairs unit has a beautiful large window seat.  BIG BACKYARD accessible by ALL units! Two patio areas, raised garden beds, gazebo, sitting areas & a tool room! Lush greenery & plants thrive in the backyards microclimate: beautiful bougainvillea, large bird of paradise plants & a Meyer lemon tree! Great for entertaining, BBQ's, outdoor dining, relaxing, gardening & for your furry pets to play! Evening are beautiful w/backyard bistro lights illuminating the gazebo & sitting area! Just minutes from all the shops, restaurants, transportation & so much more! Great opportunity to live, own, invest in this beautiful neighborhood & well maintained property.
